title: tragia arabica var. parvifolia
intro: Tragia arabica var. parvifolia, commonly known as the small-leaved spurge or Arab spurge, is a plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Tragia arabica var. parvifolia include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antipyretic, which helps to lower fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
